definitions.explanation: A vivid, deep blue color. Originally refers to the color of the pigment ultramarine, derived from the mineral lapis lazuli.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The sky was stained deep blue.

examples.japanese: {群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The ultramarine sea was very beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{顔料|がんりょう}→顔料：19796_ganryou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧きた。
examples.english: In Japanese painting, ultramarine has been used as a traditional pigment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{群青|ぐんじょう}→群青：14067_gunjou⟧ (ultramarine pigment) + ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). ⟦{群青|ぐんじょう}→群青：14067_gunjou⟧ alone can also refer to the color, but adding ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ makes it explicitly a color name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: ultramarine sky
- {群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: deep blue sea
- {群青色|ぐんじょういろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine in deep blue

CULTURAL NOTE:
Ultramarine (⟦{群青|ぐんじょう}→群青：14067_gunjou⟧) is one of the traditional Japanese colors (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝統色|でんとうしょく}), historically valued in Japanese painting (⟦{日本画|にほんが}→日本画：18225_nihonga⟧). The pigment was originally made from the mineral {瑠璃|るり} (lapis lazuli).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧: navy blue, dark blue — a darker, more muted blue
- ⟦{藍色|あいいろ}→藍色：15519_aiiro⟧: indigo — a blue derived from plant-based indigo dye
- ⟦{瑠璃色|るりいろ}→瑠璃色：22958_ruriiro⟧: lapis lazuli blue — similar vivid blue, named after the mineral itself
